events.text: Mosby Monroe Parsons was born in Charlottesville, Virginia.
events.subject: self

events.text: Parsons was murdered by Captain Dario Garza near China, Nuevo León, Mexico.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on or about August 15 , 1865 , near China , Nuevo León , Mexico

events.text: Parsons was admitted to the bar.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was admitted to the bar in 1846

events.text: Parsons was cited for gallantry at the Battle of Sacramento.
events.subject: self
events.quote: at the Battle of Sacramento on February 28 , 1847

events.subject: self
events.quote: Parsons married Mary Wells on September 18 , 1850

events.text: Parsons was elected to the state legislature.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1856 was elected to the state legislature

events.text: Parsons became a Missouri state senator.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He became a Missouri state senator in 1858

events.text: Parsons's service as a Missouri state senator ended with the American Civil War.
events.subject: self
events.quote: serving until the American Civil War

events.text: Parsons was commissioned a brigadier general of the Confederacy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Parsons was commissioned a brigadier general of the Confederacy on November 5 , 1862

events.text: Parsons led his infantry brigade in the Battle of Prairie Grove, Arkansas, one month later.
events.subject: self
events.quote: led his infantry brigade in the Battle of Prairie Grove , Arkansas , one month later

events.text: His force participated in the attack at Helena, Arkansas.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: His force would participate in the attack at Helena , Arkansas on July 4 , 1863

events.text: Parsons assisted Richard Taylor in thwarting Nathaniel Banks' Red River Campaign in Louisiana.
events.subject: self
events.quote: assisted Richard Taylor in thwarting Union Major General Nathaniel Banks Red River Campaign of 1864 in Louisiana

events.text: Parsons was appointed a major general by Kirby Smith.
events.subject: self
events.quote: a major general by Trans-Mississippi Departmental Commander Kirby Smith on April 30 , 1864

events.text: Parsons and three companions were murdered by Captain Dario Garza near China, Nuevo León.
events.subject: self
events.quote: were murdered by Captain Dario Garza , at the head of a body of Mexican soldiers , on or about August 15 , 1865

events.text: Parsons son (Kearny Parsons) and sister (Mildred Standish), along with the family of Aaron Conrow, sued the Mexican government.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In 1868 , Parsons son ( Kearny Parsons ) and sister ( Mildred Standish ) , along with the family of Aaron Conrow , sued the Mexican government

events.text: A judgment in the amount of almost US$50,000.00 in gold was awarded to each of the plaintiffs.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In 1875 , a judgment in the amount of almost US$50,000.00 in gold was awarded to each of the plaintiffs
